# @noble/hashes 2.4.0 (vendored)

Vendored copy of the published package. MIT, audit-oriented, zero dependencies, written by
Paul Miller. Kept here because several `reserve/` entries name a hash construction and this is the
reference implementation people actually ship.

Used by: `reserve/eip-712` (keccak-256), `reserve/merkle-proofs`, `reserve/transparency-logs`,
`reserve/cid-multihash` (sha2-256).

Not wired into any build. See `../provenance.md`.
